title: Maximum surface temperature
description: Hottest point of the day-night cycle: bolometric surface temperature measured by LRO Diviner, per 0.5° cell.
method: Diviner Global Cumulative Product: bolometric brightness temperature binned at 0.5° and 0.25 h of local time (nadir, 2009-2015). Averaged to 48 local-time bins, gaps filled by periodic interpolation in local time, then the extreme of each cell's diurnal curve. Each G1K cell takes the 0.5° cell that contains its centre: finer grids add no detail.

sources.name: LRO Diviner Global Cumulative Products (GCP)
sources.citation: Williams et al. (2017), Icarus 283, 300-325; LRO-L-DLRE-5-GCP-V1.0, NASA PDS Geosciences Node
